## Details

### allowed-models-allowlist

Provider connections can restrict which models they serve; requests for models outside the allowlist skip that connection.

- Surfaces: `provider.connection.allowedModels`, `ui:EditConnectionModal`
- Verify: `tests/unit/auth-connection-allowed-models.test.ts`, `tests/unit/connection-model-rules.test.ts`

### antigravity-hub-profile

Antigravity requests present the App (Hub) client identity instead of the retired IDE profile; adds the Gemini 4 Argon tiers.

- Surfaces: `provider.antigravity.clientProfile`, `userAgent`
- Verify: `tests/unit/antigravity-client-profile.test.ts`, `tests/unit/antigravity-headers.test.ts`, `tests/unit/antigravity-version.test.ts`

### opencode-free-tier-fingerprint

OpenCode free-tier requests carry the native opencode v2 header/request deltas and the anonymous public Bearer.

- Surfaces: `headers.x-opencode-*`, `auth.anon-bearer`
- Verify: `tests/unit/opencode-native-deltas.test.ts`, `tests/unit/refactor-opencodeHeaders.test.ts`

### call-log-dedupe-correlation-fallback

The call-logs API de-duplicates in-memory and persisted entries for the same request, falling back to correlation matching when ids differ.

- Surfaces: `api:/api/usage/call-logs`, `lib/usage/completedRequestDetails`
- Verify: `tests/unit/call-logs-inmemory-dedupe.test.ts`

### call-log-artifact-preview

Retain up to CALL_LOG_ARTIFACT_PREVIEW_KB (default 8 KiB) of prompt and response preview and real error text in oversized call-log artifacts instead of wholesale omission.

- Surfaces: `lib/usage/callLogArtifacts`, `ui:RequestLoggerDetail`
- Verify: `tests/unit/call-log-artifact-preview.test.ts`

### v3852-phase-a-core-upgrades

Upstream v3.8.52 Phase A imports across 6 lanes: security/auth, SSE safety latch, Opus 5.5 / Codex GPT-6 specs, typed StrategyTraits, call-log last-used usage, and dashboard timeline.

- Surfaces: `auth`, `sse`, `providers`, `combos`, `usage`, `dashboard`
- Verify: `tests/unit/authz/handler-auth-bypass.test.ts`, `tests/unit/open-sse/safety-stop-latch.test.ts`, `tests/unit/phase-a-flagship-model-context.test.ts`, `tests/unit/cc-discovery-alias-resolve.test.ts`, `tests/unit/usage-analytics-route.test.ts`, `tests/unit/test-all-route-skipped.test.ts`
